acceptable_changes: Cut the opening speculation about the best-informed man, along with the Art Museum and Marx sentences, to compress the Langley section.
Reduced the electric tram comparison and kept the Daimler motor to one clause, as the plan allows.
Removed the Marconi/Branly hugging, frozen air and electric furnace examples.
Compressed Copernicus, Galileo and Columbus into a single clause while keeping 310 and Constantine's Cross.

Dropped the Dante tercet but kept the Lucretius line and the statement that Dante invoked the Virgin; the bridge 'The Venus of Epicurean philosophy survived in the Virgin of the Schools' is source text.
Cut Cnidos/Praxiteles, the Indian goddesses, Matthew Arnold, Isis at Edfoo, Louis XI, Whistler, and the mathematicians' straight-line passage.
Condensed the passage on St. Gaudens's health and studio visits into two sentences.
Compressed the paragraphs on the pen's crystallizing growth and on scholastic science.
Added a minimal gloss, 'among the dynamos', to the 1893 Chicago reference to cover the omitted Chicago chapter.
review_focus: Check the transition from the cut Dante tercet to 'All this was to American thought...'.
Check the transition from the horse paragraph to V8 now that the Arnold and Indian goddess material is cut.
Confirm that Langley's 'channel' is kept distinct from Adams's 'symbol of infinity', and that the repudiation of the rays is attributed to Langley.
risks: Section budgets may be uneven: the St. Gaudens section may run slightly short and the dynamo section slightly long. The total is estimated to be near 2100, but this is not measured.

The railway-train sentence was generalized from 'They (St. Gaudens and Matthew Arnold)' to 'Artists' because the Arnold setup was cut; check that this stays faithful to the source's 'and all other artists'.
summary: Abridgment of 'The Dynamo and the Virgin' that keeps the source's order and Adams's third-person ironic voice, with all eight verbatim excerpts reproduced exactly. Whole optional sentences and examples were cut first, and the rest of the source wording was largely retained.
